hebrewText: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֛ב עַל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את רָעָ֑ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא תָמִ֨ישׁוּ מִ/שָּׁ֜ם צַוְּארֹֽתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/לֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ רוֹמָ֔ה כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא

tokens.bdb: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, [phrase] (for-) asmuch as yet, [phrase] be (for which) cause, [phrase] following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), [idiom] the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, [phrase] there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, [idiom] you.
tokens.explanation: ken — assim, deste modo, portanto, desta forma

tokens.bdb: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
tokens.kjv: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: lo!; also (as expressing surprise) if
tokens.kjv: behold, if, lo, though.

tokens.bdb: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
tokens.kjv: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
tokens.kjv: family, kind(-red).

tokens.bdb: this (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.

tokens.bdb: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
tokens.kjv: adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, [phrase] displease(-ure), distress, evil((-favouredness), man, thing), [phrase] exceedingly, [idiom] great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), [phrase] mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, [phrase] not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong. (Incl. feminine raaah; as adjective or noun.).

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive)
tokens.kjv: cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.

tokens.bdb: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)
tokens.kjv: neck.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: elation, i.e. (adverbially) proudly
tokens.kjv: haughtily.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
tokens.kjv: [phrase] after, (al-) ways, [idiom] certain, [phrase] continually, [phrase] evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-) tide, (meal-), what) time, when.

tokens.bdb: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
tokens.kjv: adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, [phrase] displease(-ure), distress, evil((-favouredness), man, thing), [phrase] exceedingly, [idiom] great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), [phrase] mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, [phrase] not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong. (Incl. feminine raaah; as adjective or noun.).

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
